preamble: Retraction of the voiceless alveolo-palatal affricate [tɕ] to the postalveolar [tʃ]. The clearest documented case is the Croatian (and partly Bosnian) merger of the two Serbo-Croatian affricate series, in which ć /tɕ/ and č /tʂ/ fall together as [tʃ].

examples.note: Most Croatian and some Bosnian speakers merge č, ć /tʂ, tɕ/ (and dž, đ /dʐ, dʑ/) into postalveolar [tʃ] and [dʒ]; the merger may be complete or partial.
